channel.title: Nat Jones on Array Comics
channel.description: Recent content in Nat Jones on Array Comics

item.title: Broken Moon #1
item.description: When explosions on the moon rock the surface of the Earth, humans are all but wiped out - allowing monsters of legend to rise and take control of civilization. Vampires, with their polluted cities and human factory-farming, have thus far come out on top - but if the werewolves have anything to say about it, the vampires’ reign won’t last for long…

item.title: Broken Moon #2
item.description: Humans David and Avery only narrowly escape a vampire attack with their lives, thanks to the unexpected aid of… a pack of werewolves? Werewolf leader Rantz has decided to stop hunting humans due to their shared vampire enemy. But even working together, they’re vastly outnumbered. To seek out help, Rantz relies on the ancient tale of a madman – one they called .

item.title: Broken Moon #3
item.description: In dire need of an army, werewolves and humans searched for Frankenstein - and found him… in a city alongside scores of other patchwork people he’s sewn up along the way. But this mad, broken doctor is only interested in experimenting - quite possibly on Rantz’s and Avery’s friends - and it will take a dangerous journey to the Vampire City to convince him that the destruction of the world is at hand.

item.title: Broken Moon #4
item.description: It’s come down to this: an all-out attack on the vampires’ city stronghold, with the fate of the planet hanging in the balance. But will Frankenstein’s army be enough for the humans and werewolves to tip the scales in their favor? And how will they stop the vampires’ ocean pollution from toxifying the air itself? Don’t miss the epic finale to the horror series critics are raving about!

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #2
item.description: Warring factions of monsters in the post-apocalypse! Scores of once-mythical gill men, driven out of the sea by pollution and enourmous mutated tentacle creatures, have appeared at the edge of Korbin’s fishing village… not to attack, but to ask for help! But with what?

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #3
item.description: Korbin and his entourage of gill men have been saved from a Kraken attack by none other than Avery, David, and Keeney the Franken-werewolf! But how do Avery and Keeney know the same melody that always calms Keeney down from a rage? Old loyalties are unearthed and underwater nuclear meltdown looms in this latest issue of the hit series. Note: The digital edition (2/1/2017) for this issue was released before the print edition.

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #4
item.description: It finally becomes clear what the nuclear meltdowns have awoken: Cthulhu, the Old One, and his legacy of madness. While Lorren becomes obsessed and begins to pursue the giant god; Korbin, Keeney, David, and Avery search for allies in the form of their former enemies: vampires.

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #6
item.description: The vile threat of Cthulhu has brought every mythical monster together once again to defeat him! But a crazed, Cthulhu-mad Lorren will not be easily shut down, and when he threatens Korbin’s son, the claws of the wolf come out. "Monster mash" takes on a whole new meaning in this action-packed conclusion to the second Broken Moon mini-series!

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #5
item.description: Korbin, David, Avery, Keeney, and To’klace, along with their reluctant vampire allies, set out by boat to find the only creature who might be able to stop Cthulhu and the Tok-tok: Dagon. But Dagon is guarded by sea serpents and not even guaranteed to awaken, and Cthulhu is spreading a madness akin to nuclear radiation. The evocative horror art of Nat Jones brings the latest chapter of AGP’s post-apocalyptic hit to thrilling life! Note: The digital edition (6/7/2017) for this issue was released before the print edition.
